question: Paano mag-apply ng Locational Clearance sa negosyo online gamit ang BPLS portal ng Davao City?
answer:
To apply for a Locational Clearance (LC) for a business online using the BPLS portal of Davao City, follow these steps:

1. First, you need to secure a duly filled-out Unified Application Form. You can obtain this form from the Business Bureau's website (<https://busbureau.davaocity.gov.ph/>) or apply online at (<https://appbts.davaocity.gov.ph/>) [S2, S3].

2. After filling out the Unified Application Form, you will also need a sketch or Google map of your business location with pictures of the premise location [S3].

3. Once you have all the requirements, you can proceed to apply for the Locational Clearance online through the Business Permit and Licensing System (BPLS) portal of Davao City [S2].

For the enforcement of the Integrated Zoning Ordinance (ZO) 2019 – 2028, the Locational Clearance will be issued by the City Planning and Development Office (CPDO) – Zoning Enforcement Division [S1].

ground_truth: Online Locational Clearance for Business is filed via the appbts portal. Clients upload required forms, sketch map, and HOA consent. CPDO evaluates within 5 minutes. If approved, status updates in BPLS; if denied, a denial letter is generated for appeal to LZBAA.
